utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. Let's sync calendars after lunch—I'd like to block out times that work for most folks.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Eli. I'll grab my calendar and meet you at your place after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'll have some lemonade ready. Let's get this schedule sorted proper.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I wish the community center would just put a clear notice up. I saw Faye earlier, and she's just as confused about the timings as we are.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I know, it's been a bit scattered, but I'm working on sending out a clear schedule this afternoon—I'll make sure you and Faye get it first.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That's a relief, Rosa. Thank you—I've been needing to plan around some personal appointments, so a clear schedule would really help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, the repair drive is this weekend from 10 to 4—I had to correct the time earlier. You planning to bring something in?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I knew it was this weekend, but I keep mixing up the times. So it's 10 to 4, right? I'll write that down this time for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, 10 to 4 is correct. What do you need fixed?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got my toolbox ready for the corner lot this Saturday, Noah. You gonna come help out?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, corner lot? I thought the repair drive was at the community center. Did something change?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, they moved the truck to the corner lot—community center's out this time around.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Ira, do you know when the repair drive is coming through our street?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think it's this Saturday, but you might want to check with Vik or Quinn for the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. I'll ask Quinn about the time—I want to make sure I'm ready to help out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh good, Tess confirmed it's from 9 to 3 on Saturday — that should work with the school drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, that timing should be perfect. I'll make sure to have the garage open by 8:30 so we can start setting up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, 8:30? Tess said 9, but I guess setting up early makes sense. I can come by a bit before 9 to help unload.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia! Have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up old bikes and tools together—come join us!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, I think I heard it's Saturday from 9 to 3 at the old garage. But is that for sure? I don't want it to clash with the block party.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, that's right—9 to 3 at the old garage. No worries about the block party; they're on different weekends!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey, just checking—Saturday at 10 at the community center, right? I've got a drill to bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh yeah, Bo! Saturday at 10 at the community center is perfect—bring that drill, we'll need it for sure.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I'll be there with the drill. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Jules! I heard it's Saturday at the community center—fixing up bikes and appliances. At least, that's what someone told me.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, actually I heard from Rosa it got moved to Sunday at the community center instead. Might want to double-check before you haul that old toaster over!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Wait, Sunday? Huh, that's different from what I thought. I guess I better ask around more before I lug anything over.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hana, have you seen if that repair truck finally moved from Johnson's to the corner lot? I want to make sure we're all set for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet, Opal—let me check on that. I want to be sure we’re all lined up for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Hana. I just want to be certain everything's in place before the big day.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Mara, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? They're collecting tools and appliances to fix up for folks in need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I'm helping organize it! It's Saturday from 10am to 4pm. Do you have something to bring in for repair?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's wonderful you're involved! I've got an old toaster that's been sitting in the cupboard—think they could take a look at it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll be at the repair drive. Tools are ready.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Repair drive? Are you sure that's actually happening? I haven't heard a thing about it from anyone official.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Check the flyer Dane got. It's tomorrow at 2 PM, community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane, just to be clear, the repair drive is Saturday at 9 AM at the community center, not 2 PM—I've been telling everyone the same thing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh man, I must've mixed up the times again—9 AM at the community center, got it. Thanks for setting me straight, Vik.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem, Dane. Could you help me remind others? I don't want anyone showing up at the wrong time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey, did you hear the repair truck finally moved to the corner lot? We can get that drive cleared up this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! That's Saturday, right? At the old garage? I hope I'm remembering that right.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That's right, Saturday at the corner lot—I've got my toolbox ready and some spare parts to donate.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, you heading to the repair drive? I'm hauling stuff from Mrs. Chen's with my truck—need a hand?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds like a plan, Ira. I was just about to grab my old lamp—happy to help you load up first.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, Eli! Let's head over to Mrs. Chen's now—I've got the truck warmed up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hey Quinn, do you know if the repair drive is still set for Saturday from 10 to 4? I want to double-check before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, it's still on Saturday from 10 to 4! We could use your help—I've been telling everyone about it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks for confirming, Quinn! I'll be there—do you want me to bring any tools or just come ready to help?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm heading to the corner now to see if that truck's moved yet. Want me to grab you a coffee on the way back?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, corner? Is that where the repair drive is? I thought it was at the old garage. Yeah, coffee would be great.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, the drive sign-up's at the old garage, but the truck's stuck over by Johnson's. I'll fill you in when I'm back with your coffee.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, thanks for the update, Rosa! I'll make sure to update the flyers and spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Jules! Do you need me to help with printing the updated flyers, or are you all set?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be awesome, Rosa—thanks! I'll update the design and send it over to you for printing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I keep hearing different versions of the plan—maybe we should just show up at the community center Saturday and see what happens?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, I can clear that up, Nell! It's Saturday at the community center, 10am to 4pm — we've got repair stations and coffee covered. Want me to walk you through the details?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please! I'd love the real scoop—I've been getting bits and pieces, and it's been a bit confusing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Opal, do you know the exact schedule for the repair drive? I'm anxious it might conflict with the block party.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's Saturday at 10 AM sharp at the community center. I doubt it'll conflict—the block party's usually later in the day, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Really? I thought it was at the old garage from 9 to 3, not the community center. Are you sure about that?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Sam! Glad you're on board. Just swing by the old garage Saturday morning—any spare tools or working appliances would be a huge help!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'll be there bright and early, Cleo. I've got a couple of power tools and a working toaster that I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Sam! That toaster will be a lifesaver for someone. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Tess, I just realized I never actually confirmed with you—did you end up needing any extra hands with the transport?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, honey, I haven't checked today, but Opal swears she saw a proper repair truck by Johnson's. Want to go see?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, let's go check it out—maybe they'll have a clearer start time posted on the truck.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Rey! The repair drive—right, that's the thing where we fix stuff. I think it's this Saturday? Or was it Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I'm pretty sure it's Saturday. Sam mentioned it to me.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday, right—good, I'll put that in my phone. I still owe Jules those flyers, don't I?
